title: Poor service and inefficient processes
body:
I requested the cancellation of a credit card that had never been activated. Despite the simplicity of this request, the process remained unresolved for an entire week. I contacted customer service daily, yet each interaction resulted in the same response, with no meaningful updates, clear explanation, or indication of progress.

The handling of a subsequent callback was particularly disappointing. I had difficulty understanding the representative and politely requested assistance from an Arabic-speaking agent. Instead of accommodating my request or arranging a suitable alternative, the representative disconnected the call without explanation. I did not receive a follow-up call. This raises serious concerns regarding communication standards, professionalism, and the bank’s commitment to customer support.

Furthermore, the information provided on the bank’s website regarding instant approval for car loans does not appear to reflect the actual customer experience. In practice, even straightforward procedures can take several working days, creating unnecessary delays and inconvenience. This discrepancy between advertised service expectations and the actual process warrants clarification.

My experience with email support has been equally unsatisfactory. Responses have taken approximately a week, and after prolonged waiting, I was simply directed to the bank’s official website without receiving a practical solution to my enquiry. Such a response does little to resolve customer concerns and undermines the purpose of having a dedicated customer support channel.

title: Fraud from ENBD
body:
Dear Fraud Investigation Team,
I am writing to formally and strictly dispute an unauthorized fraudulent transaction of AED 3153.80 charged to my credit card, which has driven my account balance into a negative of -3153.80AED.
What makes this situation alarming and entirely unacceptable is that this credit card has never been activated or used by me for a single transaction in my life. It has remained locked/unused in my possession since it was issued.
Furthermore:
No OTP Was Generated or Received: At no point did I receive any One-Time Password (OTP), verification code, or transaction alert on my registered mobile number for this transaction. The absence of an OTP strongly indicates a severe security vulnerability, system bypass, or unauthorized breach on the bank's transaction processing side.
Lack of Bank Transparency: Despite filing an initial complaint, I have received zero follow-up, no explanation as to how my card data was compromised while entirely unused, and automated collection messages demanding payment for fraud I did not commit.
My Demands:
Immediate Account Reversal: Reverse the disputed charge of 3153.80 immediately and clear the negative balance on my account.
Full Investigation Report: Provide a written root-cause analysis explaining how a transaction was successfully processed on a card that has never been used, and why no multi-factor authentication (OTP) was triggered or sent to my phone.
Cease Collection Actions: Suspend all automated collection notices, text messages, or negative credit reporting regarding this disputed amount while the investigation is ongoing.
Please consider this a formal escalation. If this matter is not investigated and resolved promptly, I will be forced to escalate this complaint to the Central Bank of the UAE (Consumer Protection Department) and relevant regulatory authorities.
I expect a written response and a call from a senior fraud investigator within 48 hours.
Sincerely,
Haitham

title: Missing Funds
body: I am writing regarding a fund transfer I made on 2 October at 4:41 PM. I transferred funds from my Emirates NBD account to my personal FAB account. Normally, the funds are credited within a few minutes, but several hours passed without the amount being received. As it was already evening, I waited until the following day to check again, but the funds were still not credited. I contacted Emirates NBD and was advised that a system glitch had delayed the transaction. I have called multiple times with ENBD to see the status but no luck! Since it was the weekend, I waited until Monday, but the amount was still not credited. Emirates NBD then informed me that the transfer had been completed on their side and advised me to check with FAB. But FAB has repeatedly advised me to follow up with Emirates NBD and obtain a SWIFT copy of the transaction. Emirates NBD cannot provide one because this was a local transfer, and SWIFT documentation applies to international transfers. This is a serious matter. The amount remains unaccounted for, and I need urgent assistance in locating the funds. Please investigate the transaction immediately and confirm the status and location of my money. This situation is unacceptable, particularly as I was informed that the delay resulted from a system glitch.

title: Bad customer service
body:
Dear Emirates NBD Customer Support,

I am writing to formally express my frustration and request your urgent assistance regarding my account.

My account was converted to a non-resident account; however, it has been placed under restrictions that prevent me from accessing or using my own funds. I currently have AED 1,000 available in my account, but I am unable to use this money to make payments, including my Emirates NBD credit card payment.

Previously, I contacted your support team and was advised to submit a request to update my profile. I was informed that this process would take up to eight (8) working days. Unfortunately, that timeframe has already passed, and I have not received any update or response regarding the status of my request.

In addition, one of your customer service representatives informed me that the outstanding amount on my credit card would be deducted from my debit account. However, this has not happened. The AED 1,000 remains in my account, my credit card balance continues to increase due to unpaid amounts, and I am becoming increasingly concerned about additional interest and charges that are accumulating because I am unable to access my own funds.

This situation is causing me significant inconvenience and financial stress. I respectfully request that you:

* Provide an immediate update on the status of my profile update request.
* Remove the unnecessary restrictions on my account, or advise me of the exact steps required to restore full access.
* Process the payment from my available account balance to my credit card as previously advised, or provide an immediate alternative solution.
* Confirm what measures will be taken regarding any interest or late charges that have accumulated as a result of this unresolved issue.

I would appreciate your urgent attention to this matter and a prompt resolution. Please treat this as a priority, as I have made several attempts to resolve this issue without success.

I look forward to your immediate response.

Kind regards,

Julanie Primero

title: about call
body:
Honestly, everything about HNBD is good except their customer service by phone. Every time I call, I have to wait 10–15 minutes, and most of the time nobody answers the call.

What makes it even more frustrating is that the call is not free, so I end up losing a lot of my mobile balance just waiting. This has happened to me several times before. I have waited for around 10 minutes, only for the call to be disconnected without anyone answering, and then I have to call again and wait another 10–15 minutes.

Today, the exact same thing happened again. I waited for around 8 minutes, my mobile balance was completely deducted, and still nobody answered my call.

HNBD has many good services, but this phone customer service experience is extremely disappointing. Customers should not have to spend their own money and waste so much time just trying to speak to someone. Please improve your call centre service and make sure customers can actually reach a representative.

title: Loan Top Up
body:
When you submit a request through the app, it takes a long time before someone gets in touch with you, and you have to keep chasing and following up just to get an update on your application.

What’s more frustrating is that the required documents are not requested all at once. They ask for documents one by one, which creates unnecessary delays in the process. In my case, they even requested new records and documents when I had already updated my KYC with ENBD.

The hotline is also not very helpful, as it takes a long time to reach a live representative.

As an existing customer, I was actually the one who approached ENBD because I wanted to do business with them again. I expected a much smoother and more convenient process, especially when applying for additional funds as an existing customer.

Unfortunately, the whole experience has been very inconvenient and stressful. This is honestly not the ENBD service I expected.

title: Complaint
body: I initiated an international transaction of OMR 33 to my friend in Oman on Monday, December 2, 2024. Along with the transaction amount, a fee of OMR 5 was also debited from my account. However, the amount was not credited to my friend's account. I waited until Thursday, December 5, 2024, but there was still no credit. I then tried contacting ENBD customer care, but it was extremely difficult to get through. After several attempts, I finally managed to speak with someone. When I inquired about the transaction status, they claimed it had already been credited to the beneficiary. However, upon checking with my friend, he confirmed that the amount had not been received. I contacted the bank again, and they advised me to recall the transaction. Following their instructions, I initiated the recall process. After 15 days, on Tuesday, December 18, 2024, the recall amount was credited back to my account, but only OMR 18 was returned. The remaining OMR 15 and the OMR 5 transaction fee were lost. I attempted to resolve the issue through the bank's chat support, but there was no response from their side. This entire experience has been extremely frustrating, and the level of service provided by ENBD has been very disappointing.

title: Unaddressed fraudulent transaction and poor customer service.
body:
In July, an unauthorized and fraudulent transaction amounting to over AED 8,000 was made on my credit card. I reported this immediately and was informed by your team that the investigation would take until October. However, in August, the case was closed **not in our favor**, without any prior notification, email update, or phone call.

When we followed up with the bank, we were informed that a police complaint was required along with a “reliability letter” supposedly sent by the bank. We never received this letter. Despite multiple follow-ups, we were repeatedly asked to wait 48 hours, only to receive no update. This cycle has continued multiple times without any resolution or clear guidance.

Due to repeated calls and follow-ups, we have incurred an additional loss of approximately AED 500 in communication costs alone. This is unacceptable, especially considering that:

* We did **not** share any OTP
* No biometric or cardholder authentication was done
* The transaction was clearly unauthorized
* The credit card bill has already been paid while the dispute remains unresolved

It is extremely concerning that a fraud transaction of this magnitude has not been properly investigated or communicated. The lack of responsibility, transparency, and guidance from the bank has caused financial loss, stress, and inconvenience.

author: Ahad22

title: Poor privacy policy with to many promotions
body:
App keeps pushing notifications to pay expenses in installments despite of having specifically requested not to sent me these promotions. I can not turn off the option for Emirates NBD to share my personal details in the app. There is a toggle for it, but it is being blocked from use by the bank. Managing beneficiaries is hard to find in the app. Travel mode is hard to find in the app. Very limited customization options. Overall the basic function work, but far from a 5 star review as was requested by the bank. Even though WhatsApp has been disabled in the app as a contact source, I still receive promotions through WhatsApp from Emirates NBD and had to block this in WhatsApp and report it as spam. 
Improve layout, respect privacy and respect choices for receiving promotions or more importantly NOT receive promotions. I am also sure I just wasted my time on this review, as I don’t expect anything will be taking seriously anyway.
author: MMA1981

title: Absolutely awful
body:
This app is absolutely awful - there are no words. When they first launched it, I had to contact emirates NBD and demand I be able to switch back to the old app because this ENBD X one is so bad. 

1) Menu and available services change every few weeks 
2) History and statements are not in proper chronological order 
3) Beneficiaries are constantly disappearing and you need to re-add them
4) A lot of services that were available on the original app (and the desktop version) are not available on this app
5) Not user friendly at all - whoever did the UX was obviously an amateur and were just hired because they knew someone and/or were the cheapest option 
6) Payments made (eg credit card payments) are not listed on transactions immediately like the old app (or any financial app for that matter) so you cannot contest any payments that might not have gone through as there is no evidence/history
7) The main dashboard again is not user friendly and doesn’t show a proper summary of the most important things

The list goes on. Whoever approved this app should be fired, and whichever agency or in-house team developed this app should be fired. 

The only other banking institution which is worse is Barclays UK where you have to write a handwritten letter to the Isle of Man and sign it, and if your signature doesn’t match 100% (which obviously it won’t as I’m a human being) they reject it and you have to fly to the UK in person. That’s just how horrendous this app is.

title: Complaint Regarding Airport Transfer Booking Issue – Dragon Pass via MasterCard
body:
Dear Emirates NBD Customer Service Team,

I hope this email finds you well. I am writing to bring to your attention an issue I encountered while trying to use the airport transfer service provided through my Dragon Pass membership on the MasterCard Travel Pass platform.

As a valued Emirates NBD customer, I have a valid membership for this service. I attempted to book an airport transfer as follows:

• Flight Number: 5W7169
• Departure Airport: Abu Dhabi Zayed International Airport
• Departure Time: 14:15 (10th December 2024)
• Pick-up Location: Al-Habtoor Tower, Marina
• Passengers: 4 adults and 1 child (aged 2–5 years)
• Luggage: Standard amount for a group of this size

However, upon entering the flight information and pick-up details, the app displayed an error message stating: “No available car type found.” This issue persists despite meeting all the requirements for accessing this service.

I have attached screenshots from the app, which show the error message and the service details under “Global Airport Transfer Service.”

I kindly request that you raise a formal complaint and assist in resolving this matter at the earliest, as the service requires booking at least 48 hours in advance. Your assistance in fixing this issue would be greatly appreciated to ensure a seamless travel experience.

Looking forward to your prompt response.

Best regards,
Ankit Saraya

Highly recommend it to anyone looking for a smooth and reliable banking experience!

title: Very Bad
body:
I am deeply disappointed with Emirates NBD and their lack of flexibility when it comes to handling genuine customer mistakes. What frustrates me the most is the complete lack of empathy and unwillingness to assist a loyal customer. The entire process felt mechanical and unhelpful — as if customer satisfaction means nothing to them.

I have been banking with Emirates NBD for years, and this experience has completely changed my perception of their service. A reputable bank should be able to handle such minor issues with some degree of flexibility, especially when the request is made promptly and in good faith.

author: Elkeshk

title: Rao Mukhtiar
body:
Emirates NBD Mobile Banking App – Reliable and User-Friendly

The Emirates NBD mobile banking app is one of the best banking apps available in Dubai. The interface is clean, modern, and easy to navigate, making everyday banking very convenient. Features like instant fund transfers, bill payments, card management, and account monitoring work smoothly and save a lot of time.

Login options such as Face ID and fingerprint add an extra layer of security while keeping access quick. The app is generally stable and updates are frequent, which shows the bank is actively improving the user experience. Customer support through the app is also helpful in most cases.

title: It’s getting better, slowly
body:
I appreciate that they’re trying to improve their app slowly with the customers’ suggestions. 

It’s still not there yet in terms of functionality and ease of use as the previous app, but definitely better than first release version. 

We still can’t create a transfer again from the transfer history list with the same beneficiary, transfer value, currency and bank address. You still have to input all data again even if you made the transfer previously. In the older app, you can just click on a transfer you made before and the values will be already populated based on that transfer, all you had to do is press confirm. 

Also, the Global Equities Wealth app needs a lot of work. It’s recreating Saxo’s UI but it’s still half baked. There are so many features missing from the Saxo interface, especially Split View of the same stock invested (it’s currently combined like IB), dark mode, cant close positions easily (must sell stocks, while Saxo makes it easier by just right clicking and closing the individual positions). Among so many other points. 

I have more suggestions if you’re willing, just let me know how to contact you.
author: Zak.ak

title: The lowest level of customer service
body:
I had a problem with my credit card, while I was on my vacation. Once I arrived I called to the customer service to clarify why I got charged twice for the tickets, that I bought from the credit card 2 weeks ago and the same day I top the credit card back with the amount of the tickets. While I was on my vacation I got charged the second time, so basically the same amount for the tickets (which was fully paid already back to the credit card myself) was charged. So I called customer service, explained everything, followed my bank statement and etc. the agent told me that nothing wrong on their side, this is a problem of merchant. However, I asked him the simple question why do I have to pay for my tickets twice if the amount was already paid and don’t have those 2,000 AED in my account because I spent them on tickets. I asked him what is the explanation of paying 4,000 instead of 2,000??

He told me that I messed up myself and the only thing I have to do is cover my credit card for the second time. The level of understanding is 0. No one explained to me why do I have to do it two times if the amount of the tickets is 2,000 and I paid them already.

He told me that he could explained everything from the begging but he can’t answer my question.

To say that I’m frustrated, it’s nothing. In my home country the bank managers are always responsive and they provide the solution quickly and efficiently. 

The conclusion is that I have to pay one more time for the tickets that are fully paid and already used. The bank can’t assist you. Basically these 2,000 are going just to the bank, because the merchant for the tickets received his amount long time ago.

You better go with other bank, that this one.

author: muradmo47

title: Extremely disappointing experience with Emirates NBD.
body:
Extremely disappointing experience with Emirates NBD. The bank charges a “cash advance fee” when using a credit card for crypto-related transactions, but there is absolutely no proper warning or clear notification shown before the transaction is completed. The amount gets deducted silently, and customers only find out later after checking the statement.

When contacted, customer service simply says “it is mentioned in the terms and conditions” — hidden inside a massive 100+ page PDF that most customers will never realistically read fully. Important charges like this should be clearly displayed upfront before approving the transaction, not buried deep in documents.

On top of that, the bank has removed proper chat support and forces customers into an AI system and phone calls. Reaching a real customer care agent quickly is extremely frustrating. The AI support is one of the worst experiences I have had in a banking app.

The service feels unfair, non-transparent, and customer unfriendly. Charging hidden-style fees like this feels like pure exploitation. A major bank should prioritize transparency and proper customer support instead of trapping customers with unclear charges and poor service.

author: nrujosh

title: Clearly Need More Improvement
body:
I recently encountered an issue where the app notified me that my signature needed updating and instructed me to visit the nearest branch for an instant update. However, this was misleading there was no clear information on what documents were required.

When I arrived at the branch, I was asked for my physical passport, which I didn’t have with me at the time. After driving back home to retrieve it and returning, I was then asked for a copy of my visa. This lack of upfront communication wasted nearly two hours of my time and required two separate visits just to update a signature.

This entire process could be much more efficient if:

The app provided a clear checklist of required documents before visiting the branch.
There was an option to submit documents digitally instead of requiring in-person visits for such a simple update.
Proactive notifications explained why the signature needed updating, rather than leaving me to discover the issue by chance.
The current system is inconvenient and unnecessarily time consuming. I hope this feedback helps improve the process for future customers.

title: My experience with Emirates NBD :
body:
I have been a customer of Emirates NBD Bank for several years, and overall, my experience has been positive. Their online and mobile banking services are user-friendly, fast, and reliable, making day-to-day transactions very convenient. The customer service team is generally helpful, and I’ve been able to resolve most issues quickly.

One of the strong points of Emirates NBD is the wide range of financial products they offer, from personal accounts to business banking solutions. Their branches and ATMs are easily accessible across the UAE, which is very convenient.

That being said, there are times when customer service response can be a bit slow, especially during peak hours, and some fees (such as for international transfers) feel higher compared to other banks.

Overall, Emirates NBD is a strong and trustworthy bank in the UAE, and I would recommend it to anyone looking for reliable banking services with modern digital solutions.

author: gothu11177

title: Outstanding Banking App – Fast, Secure & Truly Next‑Level!
body:
I’ve been using the Emirates NBD ENBD X mobile banking app for a while, and it is honestly one of the best banking apps in the UAE. The app is beautifully designed, extremely fast, and very easy to navigate. Managing my accounts, cards, and transactions feels effortless.

I love how the app offers 150+ instant banking services, from card controls to statements, bill payments, and even investment options—all in one place. The DirectRemit transfers are lightning fast, and the app’s security features give complete peace of mind.

The global dashboard showing a 360° view of all my finances is a game‑changer. Even updating Emirates ID, opening deposits, or checking offers happens instantly without visiting the branch.

Overall, ENBD X sets a new standard for mobile banking. Smooth performance, powerful features, and excellent reliability. Truly a 5‑star experience!

⭐ Highly recommended! ⭐

title: Wealth account is a disaster
body:
The Wealth Account in ENBD X has caused me financial losses of more than AED 20,000. The trading system is unreliable. When I place buy or sell orders, my funds get locked, and I am unable to modify or cancel my orders while the market is moving. I have had to watch my portfolio lose money without being able to take any action.

Customer support is extremely slow. By the time they respond to complaints, the market has already moved and the financial damage is done. A trading platform should never prevent customers from managing their own orders in real time.

This has been a terrible experience, and I have completely lost confidence in the ENBD X Wealth platform. I hope the bank urgently fixes these issues before more customers suffer financial losses.

title: Title: Frustrating Apple Pay Integration for ENBD Bank Cards
body:
I am writing this review to express my dissatisfaction with the ENBD X Banking app's Apple Pay integration for ENBD bank cards. Despite submitting a complaint to customer support, I have not received any positive response or a solution to my problem. Moreover, my complaint was automatically marked as completed, even though the issue remains unresolved.

The main issue I encountered is the inability to connect my ENBD credit card, debit card, and NBD Liv card to Apple Pay. While I understand that technology can sometimes have its complexities, it is disappointing to see that other bank cards can seamlessly integrate with Apple Pay without any issues.

As an Apple user, I looked forward to utilizing the convenience of Apple Pay to make secure and effortless transactions, but unfortunately, I have been unable to fully enjoy this feature due to the app's shortcomings.

The lack of a satisfactory response or a resolution from customer support further adds to my frustration. As a banking app user, I believe that excellent customer service should be a top priority, especially when customers face technical difficulties.

I urge the team behind ENBD X Banking app to address this issue as a matter of urgency. It is crucial to rectify the Apple Pay integration problem for ENBD bank cards, as this directly impacts the overall user experience and convenience of the app.

I hope that this review catches the attention of the management of ENBD X Banking, and prompt action is taken to resolve the Apple Pay integration issue for ENBD bank cards. It is important to ensure that customers can fully utilize the app's features and enjoy a seamless banking experience.

Thank you for taking the time to read my review, and I hope that my feedback contributes to the improvement of the ENBD X Banking app.

title: Poorest Customer Service Received
body:
I called today to ask for assistance regarding the deferment that was previously promised to me specifically that I would not be charged on May 27 as part of the program intended to help ease the situation of individuals experiencing financial difficulty.
I spoke with Agent Angelo this morning, and unfortunately, I had a very disappointing experience. There was absolutely no empathy or proper customer service attitude shown during the conversation. He repeatedly told me that the service request was not processed and that there was “nothing he could do” from his end. He also asked me if I had a service request number — but how would I know if this was never properly communicated to me in the first place?
First of all, it is not the customer’s fault if the request was not properly raised or processed internally. Instead of immediately responding with “unfortunately” and “no,” he could have at least shown willingness to help by offering to raise an escalation or provide a possible remedy, even if approval was not guaranteed.
What disappointed me the most was the lack of professionalism, empathy, and proper customer handling. I previously spoke with another ENBD agent whose name I unfortunately forgot, and he was excellent very patient, helpful, and guided me properly, even assisting me with cardless withdrawal instructions. That experience was completely different from what I experienced with Agent Angelo today.
Angelo, there is no need to speak to customers as if you are above them. Customers who are already dealing with financial difficulties deserve understanding and respect. At the very least, show empathy and professionalism.
As a customer who has already paid a significant amount toward my loan, with only around AED 10,000 remaining, this experience is extremely disappointing. Once I finish my loan, I honestly plan to close my account and will no longer recommend ENBD due to this poor customer service experience.

title: Very disappointed with Emirates NBD
body:
I was in a hurry and needed to pay my bills urgently to avoid fines. I deposited cash into an ATM to my own account, but the amount was not reflected in my account.

I immediately visited the branch at Mall of the Emirates, where they told me my account had been refreshed and that the money would be credited within one hour. I also called the hotline and was told the exact same thing.

Now it has been 6–7 hours, and I still haven’t received my money.

Because of this delay, I couldn’t pay my bill on time and now I have been charged a fine of 7,000 AED. This situation happened entirely because of the bank’s failure, despite all the promises and claims of being “the best bank.”

Once I get my money back, I will close my account and switch to another bank. This level of service is unacceptable, especially in urgent situations.

title: disappointing experience
body:
Very disappointing experience with account closure on this app! I have tried multiple times to close my Fixed Deposit account, and despite more than 45 days having passed since I cancelled the card linked to the account, the app keeps showing a "request failed" message every single time, with no explanation or resolution.

I have contacted customer service repeatedly and explained the issue in detail, but with no real progress — it feels like no one is actually following up on the problem. This has been a frustrating experience, especially since I urgently need to close this account due to personal circumstances. I really hope the bank's management takes this technical issue seriously and resolves it soon, as the delay is causing genuine inconvenience to customers.

title: Strong Complaint Regarding Exponentially Increasing Late Renewal Fees
body:
I am extremely dissatisfied with the exponentially increasing late renewal fees associated with my credit card. Despite never utilizing the cards in question, I was shocked to discover that the fees had reached an amount of 420 only for being late four months due to my forgetfulness and my case of being outside for four months. Additionally, the difficulties I encountered while attempting to close the cards have only added to my frustration.

I urge you to reevaluate your late renewal fee policy and take immediate action to rectify this matter. Exponentially increasing fees without cause is unfair and undermines the trust I have placed in the bank.

title: Hidden fees and zero support for app complaints
body: Highly disappointed with the ENBD X app and the bank's dispute handling. An agent explicitly promised me a 0% interest EMI offer, and even though the payment was strictly in AED, I was hit with hidden international processing fees. Customer support told me to use the app to resolve the issue, but the app gives zero transparency or real updates on ongoing disputes. They refuse to review their own customer care call logs to verify what was promised. Other banks like ADCB and Mashreq manage their digital disputes, tracking, and customer service much more reliably. If you want transparent card management and functional app support, look elsewhere.

title: New version Not User Friendly
body: It seems like you're expressing frustration with the new version of a service. To provide feedback effectively, you might consider writing a clear and concise email outlining the specific issues you've encountered. You can structure it like this: Subject: Feedback on New Version of [Service Name] 1. **Direct Remittance:** In the previous version, I found the process of making direct remittances straightforward and user-friendly. However, in the new version, I am facing difficulties navigating through the steps and completing the transaction smoothly. Old beneficiaries are missing in this new version 2. **Adding Beneficiaries:** Adding beneficiaries used to be a simple process that allowed me to manage my account efficiently. With the new version, I find that the beneficiary management feature is not as intuitive and requires more effort to accomplish. 3. **Overall Experience:** While I understand the need for updates, the current version has become a source of frustration for me and, I believe, for other users as well. The added complexities and changes have made the app less user-friendly and have led to a decrease in the overall user experience. I kindly request that you consider addressing these concerns to ensure a more seamless and user-friendly experience for all customers. I believe that a return to the simplicity and effectiveness of the previous version would greatly benefit users.

body: Since I moved to this beta version it’s been a nightmare. It’s not user friendly and compared to old app apart from looks and feel everything is bad to worse. I can’t find required info easily. For example I can’t find Smart Pass (there is no mention that it’s no more there), for Transfers I can’t select Direct remit until I enter all details and at the end it will show whether direct remit is available for the transaction or not. Earlier once I added a payee it will show me at the beginning itself whether I can do a direct remit or not. All my old payee information is gone once I moved to ‘X’, now they can’t pull that info neither I can roll back. Earlier Menu had so many options now I don’t see them. All in all worst experience. Now it’s toooooo secure that it’s logging me out when I am doing money transfer and toggling between apps to enter data. This is crazy. title: DAILY TRANSACTION LIMIT
body:
I updated the app and have lost the option of changing the daily transaction limit on credit cards. All my transactions above 1000AED are getting declined despite the transaction limit is sufficiently high. The FAQ says go to the card control option in the request & settings tab in the card, but there is no card control option in the request & settings tab. It shows only card replacement, change pin and apply supplement card options. Kindly add the daily transaction limit option to all the cards and bank accounts separately.

The old Emirates NBD app has option in security transfer to set the daily transaction limits to CIF or to individual card. This option is not available in the new ENBD X App.

Kindly update the app and  provide this option in the new version.

title: Horrible Experience - No credit card daily transactions limit change option
body:
Can’t believe there is no option to change the credit card daily spend limit.
I always set a minimum limit of 1,000 AED on my credit card so that in case my card is compromised there shouldn’t be a fraud transaction of more than 1,000 AED. I amend the limit whenever I want to make a transaction of more than 1,000 and then change it back to 1,000. But now I’m restricted to AED 1,000 as there is no option to change that limit.
I called the call center they can’t amend it over the phone, I can’t do it on the new desktop version and I can’t amend it on the app as well.
Seriously ? Now I’m regretting why did I upgrade.

title: So clunky & longwinded
body:
The banking industry the UAE and the apps have been the most frustrating and longwinded part of relocating from the UK to UAE. The software is so slow and the amount of times clients have paid and it’s been rejected when they’ve put the details in correctly. The same goes for making payments, it’s horrendously longwinded. This applies to both business and personal. I have three banks in the UK and it is so easy to make and receive payments, never any issues and you can do it in seconds if they’re set up as a payee or that takes a minute max. It is also confirms the payee details match. Here you have to jump through hoops and wait for approvals, which can take up to eight hours. 

Honestly, the government work efficiently with apps. The banks are horrendous. My parents use FAB so may try them and someone has recommended ADCB.

It just doesn’t make sense to have such a detailed verification process only to end up with extra manual steps. It would be much better if the app automatically added Apple Pay after verification, like it used to.

Bring it back.

title: Poor password management
body: The app fails to accept valid password sequences. For example, a sequence like aA8&/_[]akbhhftFfffcGbgfccddIhbgfPkh is considered as not meeting the requirements of having mixed case letters, special characters, numbers and being at least eight characters long. It expects for a very limited subset of “special characters” and rejects any others. You must be lucky to guess the characters the app is aware of. The length validator is bluntly incorrect. On top of that you can’t copy and paste when changing the password. That’s very irritating. I’ve been using this app for more than two years and I don’t see any improvements. All they did, apparently, is a redesign—now the app is even more limited than it used to be in about two years ago.

title: Potentially the worst ever app update
body:
The launching of the new NBD X app should be a case study in how not to put your customers first.

This app is clearly not fit for purpose, especially when compared to the previous solid and excellent version.

I am now unable to make international transfers, consistently receiving “transaction failed” errors at some point after receiving confirmation. The problem is I’ve no idea when as you don’t receive any message to tell you status has now changed to failed.

There are so many extra steps to the consumer journey that it’s genuinely amazing this was ever released as fit for customer use.  E.g. to receive a smart pass pin, you must log in through 2 stages (this will take 3 attempts), click through to “my messages”, scroll through to “my activities” then click into the message. Its such a small example of a lagging app compared to best-in-class versions.  I will never understand why this app version was released for general use.

title: Not fit for purpose
body:
I recently downloaded the Emirates NBD banking app and I have to say, it is not fit for purpose. It is slow, clunky, and incredibly frustrating to use. I wish I could go back to using the old app, which was much more user-friendly and efficient.

First of all, the app takes forever to load, and even when it does finally open, it is incredibly slow to navigate. Trying to check my account balance or transfer money between accounts takes forever, and I often find myself having to restart the app multiple times just to get it to work properly.

The app is also full of bugs and glitches. I have had multiple instances where transactions were not showing up in my account, or where the app would freeze and I would have to force close it and start over.

Overall, I am incredibly disappointed with the Emirates NBD banking app. It is not up to the standards that I would expect from a major bank, and I would strongly advise anyone considering using it to look elsewhere.

title: Extremely disappointed with ENBD’s Security and Customer Support
body:
Banking with Emirates NBD (ENBD) no longer feels safe due to their poor security measures and lack of proper customer support. I recently experienced repeated fraudulent transactions on my credit card. I immediately called customer service within 30 seconds of the first alert and requested the card to be blocked. The representative assured me that the transaction had not yet gone through and confirmed the card was locked.

Despite this, the bank still allowed the transaction to be completed. To make matters worse, the investigation was abruptly closed without informing me as the cardholder. When I followed up, I was simply told that the fraud occurred due to me "disclosing my card details"—a claim that is completely baseless. The bank could not provide any evidence or even offer a written statement to support their position.

This lack of transparency and accountability is alarming. As a customer, I strongly believe this incident reflects either a serious failure in the bank’s security system or potential internal fraud. Since ENBD refused to issue any official documentation, I was unable to escalate the matter to the police for further investigation.

I’ve been a loyal ENBD customer for many years, but this experience has made it clear that my trust was misplaced. I’ve decided to end my relationship with the bank entirely.

title: ENBDX app Not up to the mark. Needs performance improvements
body:
The mobile banking application has been lacking basic functionalities for a long time. The messaging page suffers from slow loading times, and messages frequently fail to send on the first attempt, often requiring multiple tries. The response time for complaints/messages is too long. Additionally, Face ID is not working for mobile pass even though it is enabled.

As of 31/10/2024, several previous deficiencies in the ENBDX mobile app have been addressed. However, the app continues to experience slow response times. Additionally, when attempting to apply for a new credit card through the app, only a limited selection of cards is available, whereas the ENBD website offers a wide range of options. No option available to check existing application status for new credit card.There should be no difference in available options between the website and the mobile app; ideally, the app should offer customers even greater flexibility and choice.

title: Poorly designed and misleading card payment functionality
body: The NBDx app offers basically the same functionality for banking as its predecessor, but it seems to actively be trying to deceive users into not paying off full credit card balances so that the bank can earn Interest. When selecting to pay against a credit card, it only offers how much balance is left *of the most recent statement* - which is not the same as the amount currently on the card. To find this amount, you must navigate back to the opening page which cites the “total outstanding” amount. A user can then manually enter this amount, but it is misleading and unlike any other credit card platform that I have ever seen that it is not offered as a clear and easy payment option when one clicks in to pay a balance. Further, when you do pay anything, the amount is not immediately reflected - which can lead to confusion about what the ACTUAL amount remaining to be paid is. These characteristics feel dishonest and quite user-unfriendly.

title: Application Review: Highly Disappointing User Experience
body: I am extremely dissatisfied with this application and would rate it below zero if such a rating were possible. The user interface is exceptionally challenging to navigate, resulting in confusion and frustration. The lack of clear indications regarding account locations further compounds the difficulties. Moreover, the limited options provided by the application add to the overall frustration. I have also encountered issues where certain accounts are not visible during the transfer process. Comparatively, the previous version of the application was significantly better. Due to the shortcomings of this current version, I have contemplated changing banks. However, attempting to revert to the old application has proven futile as I receive a message stating that I cannot download it because I have already installed the new version. This restriction feels like a punishment, and I cannot comprehend the reasoning behind the modifications or support provided by the IT team for this aggravating "Application xNbad." Unless improvements are made or the previous version is reinstated, it appears as though the bank may inadvertently drive customers away in search of a more cooperative institution with better IT services.

title: Victim of Fraud
body: I am changing my my review as this appalling, negligence, breach of commitment. I am out of the country and I have found out that my credit card had been used in an online transaction 19 times, that said my credit limit was maximized and now I have an overdraft. I was too confident to keep my money with this bank, now I don't feel safe dealing with them. Their security features were so weak that a fraudster could do a transaction online without an OTP. I repeat I did not authorize all the transactions made. We all know that an investigation will take place, but I don't see any urgency to the people from the Call Center, a one-liner word is in process, that’s all I can do. For the past 8 years. I have protected and maintained my creditbility and have no record of any late fees nor whatsoever negative impact on my banking records but because of this irresponsibility and negligence on their end. I have now a red mark on my credit history and am now liable for paying what I don't owe to them. in the next few days, I will leave the country and this will leave a negative remark under my name. I need to clear my name and let them fix the problem that they gave me.

title: Horrible App
body:
It’s a horrendously done app. I’ll be prescriptive about  feedback so if anyone reads this, I am hoping they’ll work on the fix. 

— Pre-auth charges are committed as transactions in the app. They give you a feeling that you have already paid and the clock ticks on the interest. Balance hold is ok, but committing the transaction isn’t. 

— Transfer service to your own account only works for savings and current. If you open a flexi deposit account, they don’t come as transferable which it is, in its product feature. 

— Tech support has absolutely no idea if you call them regarding a bug or a clarification. They aren’t trained on this app. 

— Changing transfer limits, after authorisation and security Pin, changes back without notice to default. Catches you by surprise. 

— Service requests are open for ever and they don’t close / resolve even when you call the Priority Banking service and they say it’s closed. 

This is an app that isn’t ready for use. Not even as a Beta. I can’t seem to use the old app for some reasons. 

Don’t download this!!!!!!

each card should show the current expanses on top of each statement cycle

title: Removed International Transfers in AED
body: Since they updated their online banking platform, users can no longer make international transfers in AED and take advantage of significantly better overseas exchange rates. We are now stuck with the only option of making international transfers in USD, EURO, or GBP and are forced to go by NBD’s terrible inbank exchange rates. USD is 2cents off market (bad but manageable), EURO & GBP on the other hand are sometimes up to a staggering 20 CENTS OFF MARKET! So if you’re doing an international transfer in those currencies you’re basically getting robbed. Very disappointed, this is more of a downgrade than anything else.

title: Honestly infuriating
body:
I open this app maybe once or twice a month to do my basic financial activities and every time it’s an enraging experience - either I am unable to “secure a session” before even being able to log in, transfers fail and I am told to try again later, the app is under maintenance and I am told to come back later. Literally just want to do the most basic tasks that a banking app should offer, why is it always such a mission? 

Secondly, why is there no easy way on the app to report fraud? I had this issue the other day and in a panic was completely unable to report a transaction as fraudulent on the app, I had to call a call centre. Surely as a banking app that is one of your main functions / services? 

I have put up with this for 2 years as, honestly, ENBD is better than other banks in the UAE, however today was just my last straw. It shouldn’t be so difficult to simply access my own finances.

title: Damascus Street Branch
body:
After having spoken to several members of the customer services team over the telephone over the past 5 days regarding opening a bank account, I went to the branch on Damascus Street Dubai to open a bank account. 

I was met initially by a gentleman(I forgot his name). He was sitting at cubicle number 10.  He did not seem to be happy to see me or to help me at all. He really seemed upset. When I asked whether there was something wrong, he literally said: today I’m having a bad day… The conversation with him made me feel very uncomfortable. I questioned myself at some point what was I doing there? 

At the end of that awkward conversation he said to me: you will receive a message within 4 working days. I left his cubicle, again questioning myself: why did you come to Emirates NBD? Why was acting that way?

But then, just before I left the branch, I was spoken to by a delightful employee, Mrs Neha. She asked me whether my account has been opened and I told her what the gentleman told me: within 4 days.

Mrs Neha took me a separate cubicle: my account was already active! She helped me by setting up online banking, she took me through the various vital steps:

- my IBAN number.
- she helped me set up a password and a code number. 
- explained how to open a savings account 
- how I can upgrade my account to Priority banking (an option which was offered to me over the telephone based on my savings, which I’d like to transfer the to Emirates NBD soon (around £120k)
- how to pay bills online 
- how to avoid becoming a victim of telephone fraud (never disclosing your personal details especially my Emirates ID).
- how to apply for a credit card.

Whatever the first collage fell short of, Mrs Neha made up for it 100%. She did that in an eloquent, professional and friendly manner, which honestly restored my trust in Emirates NBD. Bravo to her

I’m happy to be a new customer and I’m looking forward to pleasant and fruitful relationship.

Thanks and regards,
Said Farah

title: Me
body:
Same bugs as the previous App — no real improvements just the face change. Some of the better look improvements are nicer but also misleading:
— you cannot understand your total balance, transactions are uploaded with delay so you never see your actual balance immediately  or even an hour after spent/received money 
— no info on total spend per account per month to help plan the budget (elementary thing many banks offer)
— for deposit products not clear what is the offered rate — you suggest applying for account opening without letting know what is actual % you promise to client
— sliding thing on the right looks nice but not clear why it is there — totally dysfunctional thing (why to clog the space with this?)
— ordering statements — ordered bank verified statement through the app, got message thy the statement is ready but where to get it remains unknown, have to write to support to find out (some strange partial service — better simply write — “go to bank branch and get your statement”, at least no wasted time hoping service actually works)

And, dear NBD team, writing in reply to a review “write us an email and we will resolve” is not at all professional—better tell your customers when and how you will test the App properly and fix its distinctions. 
Reviews are written here already — read them, act on them, and do not request additional emails and don’t steal time of your clients for this unnecessary communication please.

Thank you — hope to see real improvements soon.

title: completely non-usable UX
body:
the app UX is awful, one of worst banking app experience ever:

1) there is no way i can submit a support request, i have to go through a forest of ‘support items’ and their submenus to pick the ‘right’ item and in the end i’m getting an error - this product is not supported for you. 
Support request this is a place where the customer writes about his problem to your support center, the one implemented is not usable and doesn’t work. Also i found a ‘messaging’ functionality but guess what - there is no way to send a message, it says - unable to send

2) in transfer and pay menu i have a notice saying ‘keep your address up to date with smooth transfer’ showing 2 links which are not clickable

3) there is no option to transfer money from current account to the prepaid card, only between accounts

4) there is no option to cancel sms transaction notifications and have in-app notifications instead - you can try to disable sms, but it doesn’t work. in-app transaction notifications do not work either 

5) i couldn’t find a way to change a pin for the card in the app. 

6) the app doesn’t t provide mobile-oriented design for many items. for example fees and charges loads from the web, which is expected to be ‘mobile friendly’, but it’s not. this is not the only example.

7) why does a banking app has nick name option, is it facebook or instagram? what’s the idea behind? 

8) purse transactions are showed with 0 value even though they were not

it’s 2022, not 2010, you can’t make such a misery banking app for the one of the largest banks in UAE

title: Critical Feedback: Automated Customer Service & AI Virtual Assistant Experience.
body:
Quality is what guides any business to success, but Emirates NBD urgently needs to step into its clients' shoes and test its own services. 

As a customer, I am facing constant friction with the automated support system. The AI virtual assistant works for standard, pre-trained queries, but for anything slightly custom, it gets lost and repeats itself indefinitely. When you explicitly ask to speak to a human representative, it stubbornly insists it can handle the issue. 

The experience on WhatsApp is equally unreliable. To make matters worse, after finally persuading the voice assistant over the phone to transfer the call, the system routes straight to the agent evaluation feedback survey before a human agent ever speaks to you. 

Technology should streamline client support, not make simple problem-solving nearly impossible.

title: Debit Card Service Needs Improvement
body:
Most of the services provided by Emirates NBD are very good, and I am satisfied with the overall banking experience.

However, I faced an issue with my new debit card delivery. The card was not delivered and was returned to the bank. Unfortunately, the app does not provide any option to raise a complaint about this issue.

When I try to apply for a new card through the “Block and Replace Debit Card” option, it says, “You are not eligible for this service.”

There is also no proper live chat or messaging option available to resolve this issue.

If Emirates NBD improves its customer support options within the app and provides an easy way to report delivery issues and request a replacement card, the overall banking experience would be much better.

I hope the bank takes this feedback seriously and improves this service.
